messages:
Tess (docs): quick heads-up — noticed /responses examples use inconsistent discriminator keys ("kind" / "variant") and some examples use no discriminator at all. That makes the JS/TS SDK generator pick the wrong oneOf branch in our generated samples. Also the upload curl snippet drops the explicit boundary which breaks copy/paste.

Ibrahim (eng-runtime): thanks. can you link the YAML and a failing generated sample so i can repro locally?

Tess (docs): YAML: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/blob/main/openapi/responses.yaml#L200-L230 ; failing SDK output: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-inference/tmp/sdk-examples-wrong-2026-04.json

Marta (sdk): our generator looks for a discriminator named "variant" and an explicit mapping. when absent it flattens the union and the sample code becomes ambiguous. docs-only change seems safest (update examples to include "variant").

Tess (docs): proposed example for the chat variant to be added to the spec/examples:
```json
{ "variant": "chat", "messages": [{ "role": "assistant", "content": "Hi there" }] }
```
and for the upload curl snippet, add an explicit boundary so folks can copy/paste directly:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/uploads" \
  -H "Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----RedwoodUploadBoundary" \
  --data-binary $'------RedwoodUploadBoundary\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="greeting.txt"\r\nContent-Type: text/plain\r\n\r\nhello\r\n------RedwoodUploadBoundary--'
```

Ibrahim (eng-runtime): SGTM. I'll open a small PR that updates the examples and adds a one-line note in docs/migration.md explaining examples now show the discriminator property to help SDK generators. no runtime changes.

Marta (sdk): please also add a Node FormData snippet to keep parity with SDK samples. example:
```js
const FormData = require('form-data');
const fs = require('fs');
const f = new FormData();
f.append('file', fs.createReadStream('greeting.txt'));
await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', body: f, headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${API_KEY}` } });
```

CI (docs-bot): PR #5240 opened by ibrahim: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5240 - updates examples to include "variant", fixes multipart curl snippet, adds Node FormData example and migration note. CI: docs-lint OK, sample-tests OK.

Elena (pm): confirming this is docs-only and safe to merge. good to include the migration note so integrators aren't surprised.

Tess (docs): i'll review the PR and spot-check staging after deploy. thanks everyone :sparkles:
